win.landed: This release adds a caching layer that reuses previously rendered output instead of re-rendering it on every request.
win.evidence: 42 of 42 render tests pass. p95 render time dropped from 640ms to 210ms on the staging fleet.
win.next: Roll the cache out to the production fleet next.

bullets: Render latency measured before and after the change on the staging fleet
No regressions found across the render test suite
Cache eviction policy documented for the on-call rotation
